subject: warning message: In validDetails.polygon(x) : NAs introduced by coercion

messages.author: 146c5031f31e4913
messages.subject: warning message: In validDetails.polygon(x) : NAs introduced by coercion
parts:
Hi all, 

I had a plot which worked before I updated to the new packages; fairly certain I properly updated and restarted R etc... (session info below)

Here's the reproducible example:

library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)

m <- ggplot(geyser, aes(x = duration, y = waiting)) + geom_point() + xlim(0.5, 6) + ylim(40, 110)
m <- m + stat_density2d(aes(fill = ..level..), geom="polygon")
(m)

results with a plot, but no polygon "heatmap" on top of the points, and the following message:

Warning message:
In validDetails.polygon(x) : NAs introduced by coercion

I don't know what I'm doing wrong, but if anyone knows, it would be a great help. 

-Jake
